evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official public no-login 'Buildings of local importance' page identifies the city's Local List of non-designated heritage assets and states that these are buildings/structures of local historic, architectural or social importance, including distinctive building types and styles. The page directs readers to Exeter Local Plan First Review Schedule 5 for the register, but this selected official page window publishes no record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable building footprint geometry. Accordingly, only source-area/register metadata was verified; no individual building footprint was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Selected official Local List page publishes no record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable building footprint geometry.
field_evidence.type_use: Official council page states the Local List comprises buildings/structures of historic, architectural or social importance and includes distinctive building types/styles; no individual record was exposed in this selected page window.
field_evidence.source_area: Official current Exeter City Council Local List/register-index page was read; source-area/register metadata only.
